definitions.gloss: to push down; to thrust off; to knock off (a ledge, etc.)
definitions.explanation: To forcefully push someone or something downward, causing them to fall from a height or elevated position.

definitions.gloss: to plunge (into despair); to push (into misfortune)
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, to cause someone to fall into a negative state such as despair, misfortune, or a difficult situation.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧)
- Pattern: X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧Y⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{突|つ}き{落|お}とす

COMPOUND VERB STRUCTURE:
⟦{突|つ}く→突く：12735_tsuku⟧ (to thrust/push) + ⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧ (to drop/let fall) = to push down forcefully

ASPECT (ている):
{突|つ}き{落|お}として⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ can mean either:
- In the process of pushing down (ongoing)
- Has pushed down (resultant state, less common)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{突|つ}き{落|お}とす - to push down the stairs
- ⟦{崖|がけ}→崖：05391_gake⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{突|つ}き{落|お}とす - to push off a cliff
- ⟦{絶望|ぜつぼう}→絶望：04863_zetsubou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{突|つ}き{落|お}とす - to plunge into despair
- ⟦{不幸|ふこう}→不幸：03595_fukou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{突|つ}き{落|お}とす - to thrust into misfortune
- ⟦{地獄|じごく}→地獄：12053_jigoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{突|つ}き{落|お}とす - to cast into hell

USAGE:
Often appears in crime reports, dramatic narratives, and figurative expressions about emotional devastation. The physical sense implies violent intent.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{突|つ}き{飛|と}ばす→突き飛ばす：06135_tsukitobasu⟧ - to push away (horizontally)
- ⟦{押|お}し{倒|たお}す→押し倒す：06047_oshitaosu⟧ - to push over
- ⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧ - to drop (without the forceful pushing)
